title: EF ECOFLOW Portable Power Station DELTA 3 Max, 2048Wh LiFePO4 Battery, Solar Generator (Solar Panel Optional), 3400W X-Boost Output, Ultra-Fast 0-80% Charging in 1.13 Hr, Home Backup & RV Camping
features: Ultra-Fast Charging, 0–80% in Just 1.13 Hours – Thanks to EcoFlow’s advanced X-Stream technology, DELTA 3 Max can recharge from 0–80% in just over an hour. That means less waiting and more doing, whether you’re preparing for a blackout, charging before a road trip, or topping up at the campsite. Reliable power is always ready when you need it most.

Up to 3400W Continuous X-Boost Mode – Power 99% of Appliances – With an impressive 3400W X-Boost output, this portable power station easily runs high-demand appliances like fridges, microwaves, and even power tools. From emergency backup to RV adventures, enjoy peace of mind knowing your essentials stay powered without overload.

Ultra-Quiet Performance & Rapid 10ms Transfer Time – Designed for home backup, DELTA 3 Max kicks in with less than 10ms transfer time, keeping sensitive electronics like computers and medical devices safe from outages. Plus, its ultra-quiet operation ensures your nights remain peaceful—no noisy distractions during use.

Lighter & Durable Design, Built for 10 Years of Daily Use – DELTA 3 Max engineered with a long-lasting LiFePO4 battery. Its lighter, durable build makes it easier to carry from your home to your RV or campsite without sacrificing strength or performance. EcoFlow DELTA3 Max electric generator also comes with an extended 5-year service.

Smarter App Control – Save on Costs Without Sacrificing Comfort – Connect with the EcoFlow app to monitor energy use in real time, set smart priorities, and cut electricity costs. Easily manage charging and discharging schedules, all while ensuring your comfort and convenience remain top priority.
